memory_candidates.content: The .claude/extensions/core/skills/*/SKILL.md mirrors under the core extension are a separate deployment source from the deployed .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md copies. Updates applied only to the deployed copies (e.g. task 775's Stage 4a --lit rewrite) do not propagate to these mirrors, creating latent drift: a future 'Load Core Agent System' sync would silently revert the deployed rewrite by re-deploying from the stale mirror. When a task modifies a deployed skill's SKILL.md, check whether the corresponding extensions/core/skills/ mirror also needs the same edit, or explicitly record the mirror as an out-of-scope follow-up.
